messages.english: Follow saved grower cycles on their exact planned dates.
messages.text: Landzela mirhendzeleko yo rima leyi hlayisiweke hi masiku ya yona lama kunguhatiweke hi ku kongoma.

messages.english: Check current designs before ticking work or exporting dates.
messages.text: Kambela tidizayini ta sweswi u nga si fungha mintirho kumbe ku humesa masiku.

messages.english: Keep own crop estimates separate from catalogue print advice.
messages.text: Hlayisa mimpimo ya wena ya swibyariwa yi hambanile ni switsundzuxo leswi kandziyisiwaka swa khathalogo.
Kambela mintirho ya wena leyi nga ni masiku

messages.english: Task Planner → Dated work from your estimates
messages.text: Mupulani wa Mintirho → Mintirho leyi nga ni masiku ku suka eka mimpimo ya wena

messages.english: Open Task Planner to check work dates from your saved growing estimates.
messages.text: Pfula Mupulani wa Mintirho leswaku u kambela masiku ya mintirho ku suka eka mimpimo ya wena yo rima leyi hlayisiweke.
